_usage: Run from ydelta/ root: `yarn setup:init-market --config .local/markets-config.json` (after copying this template and filling in real values).
_setup: 2. Edit .local/markets-config.json — replace every placeholder with a real base58 pubkey. Add more entries to the `markets` array for additional markets.
_notes: Each entry creates one yDelta market (CreateMarket + CreateVault for the debt mint).
Markets sharing a debtMint share one GlobalVault — created on the first market, skipped (idempotent) on subsequent ones.
Markets start PAUSED. Unpause via SetMarketPause(false) after risk profiles exist, or set `unpauseAfterSetup: true` and re-run.
On any failure the batch stops; succeeded markets remain on-chain. Fix the bad entry and re-run — already-created markets skip themselves.
Set `marketKeypair` to a keypair.json path to pin a market's address across retries. Without it, each run mints a fresh keypair.

markets.name: <human-readable label, e.g. USDC/SOL>
markets.debtMint: <base58 pubkey of the debt mint (what borrowers borrow)>
markets.marginfiGroup: <base58 pubkey of the marginfi group hosting both banks>
markets.debtBank: <base58 pubkey of the marginfi bank for debtMint>
markets.collateralBank: <base58 pubkey of the marginfi bank for collateralMint>
markets.marketKeypair: <OPTIONAL path to a market keypair.json — set this to make re-runs idempotent against a specific market address>
